title: Purple End Lighting
description: A simple data pack that changes the end lighting color to purple.
body:
This is a simple data pack that utilizes the `ambient_light_color` attribute in `dimension_type/the_end.json`. This gives the ambient light a purple-ish hue, however `sky_color` and `sky_light_color` are also slightly changed to fit with the ambient light.

**This is INCOMPATIBLE with Minecraft versions under 26.1!** This is because `ambient_light_color` was not introduced until this verison.

**This does NOT automatically work in multiplayer!** You must upload the data pack to your server in order to use it there.

This is a vanilla data pack, so no mods are required. A mod that disables the "experimental settings" warning (such as Experimentalist) is recommended, however.
